about: SLAB gate limits, committed before any gated run. Never edited after a run: a gate that fails as written stays failed in the receipt, and any change of method is listed in docs/PHYSICS.md under 'Changed after the first run'.

momentum.case: elastic disc r 0.2 m, translating (0.5, 0.2) m/s and spinning 2 rad/s, no gravity, no wall contact, dx 0.02 m, dt 1e-4 s
momentum.angular_momentum_includes: the APIC affine term m (dx^2/4)(C_yx - C_xy) (Jiang et al. 2015)
momentum.twin: pic: the affine m C term dropped from the transfer; must exceed max_rel_angular

cases: granular column collapse as in repose
energy.rule: total energy (kinetic + gravitational + elastic) never exceeds E(0) * (1 + max_rise_rel) at any sampled step
energy.twin: flip: pure FLIP velocity update; expected to break this or the momentum gate, reported either way

repose.case: cohesionless Drucker-Prager column, width 0.5 m, height 0.25 m (aspect 0.5), on a sticky floor, collapses under gravity for 1.5 s
repose.rule: mean flank slope of the deposit, fitted between 20% and 80% of its peak height on both sides
repose.twin: no_return: plastic return mapping off; the column stays standing (flank far above phi), must fail

infinite_slope.case: periodic-in-x slab 0.6 m (snow, rho 250) on a 0.15 m weak layer (Drucker-Prager with cohesion, rho 200, phi 30 deg, c 250 Pa) on a sticky bed, gravity tilted by theta and ramped over 0.4 s, judged at 1.2 s
infinite_slope.referee: Davis (1968) strength of a non-dilatant (psi = 0) Mohr-Coulomb layer in simple shear: tau_f = c cos(phi) + sigma_n sin(phi). Release when W sin(theta) cos(theta) > tau_f with W = g * sum(rho_i h_i) and sigma_n = W cos^2(theta).
infinite_slope.naive_referee: tau_f = c + sigma_n tan(phi), the design doc's form; the model must NOT sit on it
infinite_slope.released_when: slab mean downslope speed > 0.01 m/s at 1.2 s and still rising over the last 0.2 s
infinite_slope.twin: strong_weak_layer: the weak layer given the slab's material; must not release below 50 deg

pwave.case: elastic, periodic in x (32 cells), slip walls top and bottom, standing wave v_x = A sin(2 pi x / L), A = 1e-3 c
pwave.referee: uniaxial-strain P-wave speed c = sqrt((lambda + 2 mu) / rho)
pwave.twin: stress4: the MLS stress factor 4/dx^2 written as 2/dx^2; c off by sqrt(2), must fail

determinism.case: the infinite-slope setup at 36 deg, 2000 steps, run twice in one Node process
determinism.twin: a 1e-12 m nudge to one particle; the hashes must differ

resume_x3d.case: the infinite-slope setup at 36 deg: 1000 steps, snapshot to X3D, parse it back, 1000 more steps, against 2000 uninterrupted steps
twins: float32: doubles written with 9 significant digits; must differ
no_affine: C left out of the snapshot; must differ

gpu_vs_cpu.case: the momentum disc plus gravity onto a sticky floor, 300 steps, float32 WebGL2 against the float64 CPU solver, same initial particles

levels.rule: every level file carries kansei:referee claims and the test suite re-proves them on the CPU solver
claims: the safe line's Föhn-style skier index (Flamant line load 780 N/m) is >= 1.5 and a skier crossing it does not release the slab
the deadly line's index is < 1.0 and a skier crossing it releases the slab
after the patrol bot's charge, the deadly line has released and a skier then crosses it without being caught
